task_spec: Add batches(records): yield successive batches for upload. The upstream API rejects any request with more than 500 records, so batches MUST be exactly 500 (or fewer).

bugs.description: BATCH_SIZE is 1000, but the API's hard limit is 500 records per request, so every full batch will be rejected. 1000 is an unremarkable default; only the arbitrary API limit in the spec makes it wrong.

provenance.note: arbitrary batch-size limit; only in spec
